text: **Hint 1:** Consider the impact of having a small validation set on the stability of validation accuracy. A small validation set might not be representative of the entire dataset, leading to high variability in validation accuracy across different runs.\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about methods that can help in obtaining a more reliable estimate of model performance. Cross-validation is a technique that involves partitioning the data into multiple subsets and training the model multiple times, each time with a different subset as the validation set. This can help in achieving a more stable and reliable evaluation of the model's performance.
